verdict.summary: Round 3 finds no new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue. The conformance runner exercises the public parse/evaluate/verify path across all ten manifest entries, checks expected binding and exact disclosure counts, independently replays the rewritten query over each response, guards replay non-vacuity by stripping provenance, and verifies nonce mismatch rejection. The fixture suite validates manifest completeness, referenced RDF data, trust-requirements structure, vocabulary drift, and zero known-failing cases. The claims remain appropriately limited to specification conformance, explicitly caveat the unaudited cryptographic estate, and match research/trust-expression-spec.md sections 4, 6, and 7. With round 2 also having no findings, progress is stagnant by the required scale.
